learning_outcomes.text: Describe the mechanical equivalent models of rigid body statics. Furthermore, know the simplifying assumptions for the models and their application limits.
Assess under which practical conditions the various equivalent models are used.
Describe real problems from mechanical engineering using static methods and solve the associated mathematical problem.
Interpret the solution to the problem and, in particular, assess whether the respective mechanical model sufficiently describes the problem under consideration.

syllabus_topics: General force and moment vector on a rigid body
Equilibrium conditions for general force systems
Internal forces and moments on frames and beams
Independence in developing complex problem solutions
Design of components and processing of questions within the framework of design theory
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the exam. The grade is determined by the passing exam.
bibliography: Gross, D., Hauger, W.: Technische Mechanik 1
